tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are organizing a university theater production and need to rent costumes for the cast. You want to contact a local costume shop to inquire about their rental options, prices, and availability. You also need to know if they offer fitting services for the actors. Write an email to the costume shop manager, Ms. Parker.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the university theater production.
Ask about rental options, prices, and availability for costumes.
tasks.to: the costume shop manager, Ms. Parker
tasks.subject: Costume Rentals for a Community Theater Production
